scope: One-hop explicitly linked GitHub source files, commit patches, PR metadata/patches, and linked issue discussions. Branch links reflect retrieval-time content unless resolved to a commit. No recursive expansion or external attachments.

links.reason: Historical source recovered. Original branch target and case-time equivalence are unknown; do not infer deployment or resolution. Original line anchor is retained in URL; not relocated to a guessed matching line.
links.recovery_method: Exact repository/path REST Git history; explicit commit or verified direct parent; full source retained
